name: quantcalc
description: Run real Monte Carlo retirement projections, get the tax-aware withdrawal order and Roth-conversion programme the engine selects, compare published capital market assumptions, estimate a 2026 federal and state tax return and rank one household's 2026 state tax in all 50 states and DC (both with a licence key) — computed on the QuantCalc engine, not estimated by the model.

license_key.title: QuantCalc PRO licence key
license_key.description: Optional. Without one, projections run at 2,000 paths and the tax-aware tool returns the first retirement year of its schedule. A PRO key raises runs to 10,000 paths and returns the full schedule, and a PRO or Tax Season Pass key enables the 2026 return estimate and the every-state ranking; it is held at the connection, never passed through the conversation.
